cleanupDefect.wrongLookup: GET /templates/{name} used an alias where the route requires a template ID; a 404 was incorrectly interpreted as absence.
cleanupDefect.correctLookup: GET /templates/aliases/{alias} resolves templateID; inspect the exact ID and name/private status, DELETE that ID, then verify ID 404. If a recorded ID is known, alias 404 cannot replace the ID lookup.
cleanupDefect.historicalConclusion: All 40 exact private template IDs below were still present when recovered. Earlier name-as-ID absent receipts did not prove deletion. Sandbox enumeration and termination evidence is separate.

anonymousProbe.purpose: Observe one existing failed desktop image without credentials or provider/model requests; this diagnostic budget does not change the formal 45-second gate.
anonymousProbe.interpretation: This sample spent 17.4 seconds before spawning the CLIs and then showed repeated D-state I/O waits. Both model responses were followed by exit/close within milliseconds; catalogue output was followed by an empty handle set and process exit. It supports a cold import/page-read explanation rather than a handle leak, but is not a trace of the original timed-out command and is not production dispatch latency.
